title: Next.js & Full-Stack Web
description: Build production full-stack React applications with Next.js App Router, Server Components, Server Actions, Route Handlers, authentication, database integration, and deployment.
outcomes: Structure scalable apps using App Router file conventions, nested layouts, and dynamic routes
Keep client bundles tiny by composing React Server Components with focused 'use client' islands
Mutate database records safely using Server Actions, Zod validation, and cache revalidation
Secure routes with HttpOnly session cookies, middleware, and ship standalone Docker/VPS builds
